summary: Full-stack test of LeadPilot AI. Backend: 25 pytest tests across auth (demo/email login, JWT, bcrypt format), dashboard/org/agent, leads CRUD + CSV import + stage update, THE AI-call killer endpoint (score 91/HOT/APPOINTMENT + Saturday 11:30 AM appointment + follow-up + LLM summary) with persistence re-fetch, appointments/calls/activities — 25/25 passing. Frontend: demo login, dashboard KPIs, leads table+11 filters+search, Add Lead, Import CSV, complete killer flow (AI call modal -> progressive transcript -> result 91/HOT/Saturday 11:30 AM -> View updated lead -> lead profile shows 91/100, HOT LEAD, APPOINTMENT, AI summary, extracted info, breakdown +25/+20/+20/+15/+11, transcript modal), persistence after browser refresh, Pipeline kanban (Rahul in APPOINTMENT), Appointments, Calls modal, Agent save, Settings, logout + route protection, invalid-credential error, mobile 390px (no horizontal overflow). No blocking issues found.

minor.issue: No organization_id filter — returns all tenants' data. Also GET/PUT /api/leads/{id}, /stage and /ai-call do not verify the lead belongs to the caller's organization (IDOR).
find_one result used without a None guard — would raise 500 (TypeError) if the seeded demo user is missing.
Returns 200 instead of 201 for resource creation.
Accepts any arbitrary status string (no enum validation) and returns 200 with null-ish body for a non-existent lead id instead of 404.
No rate limiting / brute-force lockout (playbook expects lockout after 5 failed attempts). JWT is returned in the body for localStorage (per product choice), so no httpOnly cookie is set.
allow_credentials=True combined with default allow_origins='*' is an invalid/unsafe combination; set explicit CORS_ORIGINS.

ui_bugs.issue: Radix console error: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for accessibility' (plus missing aria-describedby). Reproduces every time the AI call modal opens.
If POST /api/leads/{id}/ai-call fails, the catch block silently calls onClose() — the user gets no error feedback/toast and no retry.

issues: Seeded appointment day labels do not match their dates: cards show 'Saturday · 2026-08-30' (actually Sunday) and 'Sunday · 2026-08-31' (actually Monday) because seed() assigns day names round-robin independent of the date. Rahul's AI-call appointment (Saturday · 2026-09-05) is correct.

action_items: Add DialogTitle (VisuallyHidden if needed) to AICallModal DialogContent to clear the a11y console error
Show an error toast instead of silently closing AICallModal when the ai-call API fails
Scope /api/appointments, /api/calls, /api/activities and lead-by-id routes to the caller's organization_id
Derive appointment 'day' from the actual date in seed() so day names match dates
Add None guard in /api/auth/demo and 404 handling + status enum validation in /api/leads/{id}/stage
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 808 lines and mixes config, seed data, scoring, LLM and routes — split into modules (routes/, seed.py, scoring.py) before it grows further
All list endpoints except /api/leads ignore organization_id; multi-tenancy is effectively unenforced
Test files placed in /app/backend/tests trigger uvicorn --reload restarts (watchfiles); harmless here but noisy in logs

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (killer flow, all 8 pages, auth, persistence)

DB is back to the 22 seeded leads. Rahul Sharma was reset to CONTACTED/score 42 with calls/appointments/follow-ups cleared via /app/backend/tests/reset_rahul.py so the demo starts fresh.
test_credentials: demo@urbannest.ai / demo1234 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md); one-click 'Try Demo Account' button also verified

Backend suite: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -q -n 0` (pytest.ini runs -n 2 --dist loadscope; the appointments assertion was made ordering-independent because the Rahul appointment only exists after the AI-call test). rca_of_the_issue: No functional defect found. The one initial pytest failure (TestOther::test_appointments) was a test-side ordering race under xdist (appointments class ran on a different worker before the AI-call class created Rahul's appointment); fixed in the test file, now passes both serially and in parallel.
